description: A landscape photograph depicting a dry, arid, or semi-arid environment under a clear blue sky. In the foreground, the terrain is mostly bare soil with scattered low, dry shrubs and bushes. The midground features several white or light-coloured low-rise buildings, likely agricultural structures such as greenhouses or covered cultivation areas, surrounded by some greener trees and what appears to be a linear dark structure, possibly a road or cultivated strip. The background is dominated by rolling hills with steep slopes, which are sparsely vegetated with dry, brownish-grey scrub and scattered small bushes, consistent with the document's definition of "Sparsely vegetated areas" (Class 6.1). A lighter, possibly eroded or excavated area is visible on the left slope of the background hills. The overall scene shows a transition from human-modified agricultural/developed land to natural, sparsely vegetated hilly terrain.
